'''Locus''' was a [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], that served as the world's [[Capital/Legends|capital]].

==Description==
Locus was divided up into a number of different zones that were each controlled by different factions. The largest zone was the [[Corporate City Sector]], which was run by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and contained facilities for CSA operations and employees. The next largest sector was the [[Republic Sector]], which was considered the most recognizable part of the [[City/Legends|city]] and changed hands a number of times throughout Nyriaan's history.

The [[Neutral Zone]] at the center of the city contained the planetary government and Nyriaan's only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The majority of Nyriaan's crime occurred inside the Neutral Zone, with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] operating freely within the sector's confines.

Other sectors included the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guild Sector]] and the [[Mining Guild Sector]]. In addition, there were four more sectors, including ones controlled by the [[Tapani]] nobility and native [[Nyriaanan]]s.

==History==
Locus was constructed around the remains of the ''[[Locus]]'', a survey [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] that crash-landed on Nyriaan in [[87 BBY/Legends|87 BBY]].

In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] passed the [[Luire Accord]] in an attempt to resolve the tensions among the inhabitants of Nyriaan, and under the terms of the agreement, Locus was split up into a number of different sectors. It also became the site of a new planetary government, the [[Nyriaan Concord]].

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] later replaced the Republic as the dominant galactic government and in [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]], the Empire began construction of an [[Ion shield/Legends|ion shielding]] station just outside Locus.
